exclusion_reasons.label: Not the target population/procedure
exclusion_reasons.description: Population is not adults undergoing cardiac surgery (e.g., non-surgical, non-cardiac surgery).

exclusion_reasons.label: Wrong setting/procedure
exclusion_reasons.description: Study focuses on transcatheter cardiac procedures, heart transplantation, or VAD implantation without eligible surgical cohorts.

exclusion_reasons.label: Not SGLT2 inhibitor exposure
exclusion_reasons.description: Intervention/exposure does not include an SGLT2 inhibitor agent or class.

exclusion_reasons.label: Exposure not perioperative/preoperative
exclusion_reasons.description: SGLT2 exposure is unrelated to the index surgical episode (e.g., chronic outpatient use only without perioperative relevance).

exclusion_reasons.label: No eligible comparator
exclusion_reasons.description: No non-SGLT2 comparator, placebo, or standard care arm available.

exclusion_reasons.label: Ineligible study design
exclusion_reasons.description: Non-comparative design (single-arm), case series, case report, narrative review, editorial, or letter without original comparative data.

exclusion_reasons.label: Not human
exclusion_reasons.description: Animal, in vitro, or preclinical research.

exclusion_reasons.label: Pediatric population
exclusion_reasons.description: Participants are <18 years old or predominantly pediatric.

exclusion_reasons.label: Non-original/secondary source
exclusion_reasons.description: Review, guideline, commentary, or other non-original research.

exclusion_reasons.label: Conference abstract only
exclusion_reasons.description: Abstract without a corresponding full-text article available.

exclusion_reasons.label: Duplicate/superseded
exclusion_reasons.description: Duplicate record or superseded by a more complete publication.

exclusion_reasons.label: No relevant outcomes
exclusion_reasons.description: Does not report any of the prespecified outcomes.

human_decisions_required.question: Should isolated transcatheter cardiac procedures (e.g., TAVR/TAVI, MitraClip, WATCHMAN) be included?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Including these procedures broadens the population beyond open surgical cardiac procedures and may introduce different perioperative risk profiles and care pathways.
suggested_options: Include only if converted to open surgery or combined with open surgical procedures

human_decisions_required.question: Should heart transplantation be included?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Transplant recipients have distinct perioperative management and outcomes that may not generalize to routine cardiac surgery.

human_decisions_required.question: Should durable ventricular assist device (VAD) implantation be included?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: VAD implantation involves unique indications and perioperative considerations distinct from CABG/valve/aortic surgery.

human_decisions_required.question: What perioperative exposure window qualifies as eligible SGLT2 inhibitor exposure?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Defines which studies qualify (e.g., chronic users up to day of surgery; initiation within a defined pre/postoperative window).
suggested_options: Preoperative use continued up to the day of surgery (or held per protocol) counts as exposure
Initiation within 30 days pre-op to 7 days post-op counts as exposure
Restrict to exposure from 7 days pre-op to 48 hours post-op

human_decisions_required.question: If SGLT2 inhibitors are routinely withheld immediately preoperatively in chronic users, do such patients still count as exposed?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Common perioperative practice may classify users as exposed despite temporary withholding; misclassification impacts effect estimates.
suggested_options: Count as exposed if regular preoperative users (default)
Require active dosing within X days before surgery (specify window)

human_decisions_required.question: Should dual SGLT1/2 inhibitors (e.g., sotagliflozin) be included as part of the SGLT2 class?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Including dual inhibitors may introduce mechanistic heterogeneity but may be relevant to class effects.

human_decisions_required.question: Should region-specific or less widely used SGLT2 agents (e.g., ipragliflozin, luseogliflozin, tofogliflozin, remogliflozin) be included?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Affects comprehensiveness and heterogeneity; names vary across regions and indexing.
suggested_options: Include only if approved/available in study region

human_decisions_required.question: Should quasi-experimental comparative designs (e.g., before-after, interrupted time series, difference-in-differences) be eligible?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: These designs can provide comparative evidence but differ from RCTs/cohorts in risk of bias and analytic requirements.

human_decisions_required.question: Is comparison against other antidiabetic agents (without SGLT2 inhibitors) acceptable as eligible comparators?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Determines inclusion of studies comparing SGLT2 inhibitors versus other glucose-lowering therapies beyond placebo/standard care.

human_decisions_required.question: Should conference abstracts without a full-text article be included?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Affects coverage, risk of bias, and data completeness; many perioperative studies are presented first as abstracts.
suggested_options: Include if sufficient data for effect estimates
Include and seek additional information from authors
